Meet Archetype This robotic arm blends human creativity with machine intelligence as it draws, writes, and mimics nature… then erases everything to begin again. The idea comes from the artist Roy Nachum’s childhood, when he sculpted in beach sand only to have each creation washed away by the waves — a reminder that every ending is also a new beginning. Guests are invited to channel that same inspiration and create their own art in the kinetic sand on both sides of the room.
